notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote, mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (OMIM 257300). Allele 1 chr15:40209701 T>G, NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter, nonsense, rs759242053, ClinVar VCV000533901.9 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic with multiple submitters and no conflicts, condition Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1; gnomAD popmax 7.9e-05; DP46 AD21/25 GQ99 PASS. Allele 2 chr15:40220612 T>G, NM_001211.6:c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys, missense, novel with no ClinVar record and absent from gnomAD, SIFT deleterious 0.01, PolyPhen probably damaging 0.997; DP28 AD15/13 GQ99 PASS. Both on MANE Select ENST00000287598.11. Loss of function is the established BUB1B mechanism, so a nonsense allele in trans with a damaging missense fits MVA1. Trans is inferred from the recessive mechanism, not demonstrated: the alleles lie 10911 bp apart, beyond a read pair, and HaplotypeCaller PGT/PID reported no phasing group in BUB1B. Confirmation would need parental testing or long reads.

LZTR1 chr22:20996720 C>G, NM_006767.4:c.2244C>G p.Tyr748Ter, heterozygous nonsense, rs1682503990, ClinVar VCV001409252.7 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic with multiple submitters and no conflicts. Reported conditions: Noonan syndrome 10 (OMIM 616564), Noonan syndrome 2 (OMIM 605275) and LZTR1-related schwannomatosis (OMIM 615670). gnomAD popmax 1.4e-06; DP48 AD24/24 GQ99 PASS. Reported because it is an established pathogenic variant with tumour-predisposition implications warranting clinical follow-up, and because the proband's rhabdomyosarcoma, short stature and failure to thrive overlap the RASopathy phenotype, so a dual diagnosis or a modifying contribution cannot be excluded on this data. Not proposed as the primary cause: MVA1 explains the chromosomal-instability presentation and the BUB1B pair is the better fit.
